description: Paid: $1.00 per call over the Machine Payments Protocol, or one prepaid SET Agent Credits call (Authorization: Bearer <key> on the MCP request). Audits one public page from public fetches only: which of 15 search and AI crawlers its robots.txt allows (each with the deciding rule and the vendor's documentation), its indexing and snippet directives, title, meta description, canonical, JSON-LD, Open Graph, lang, h1 and server-rendered text, plus site signals (redirects, HTTPS, time to first byte, sitemap, llms.txt, llms-full.txt). Returns a 0-100 readiness score against a published rubric and prioritized findings, each with what was observed, why it matters and the fix. It implies no ranking, traffic or citation outcome. The page is checked before payment is taken; a failed check is not charged.
